reason.exactTimestampJoinAudit: An earlier exact timestamp inner-join audit paired only about 0.1% of the two streams for animal 12; this coverage loss motivated the amendment before model fitting.

alignment.anchor: Per-animal Collar Start Timestamp in the downloaded Zenodo README summary table; timestamp displayed to whole-second precision and shared by collar and halter.
alignment.timezone: Preserve source-naive wall-clock time; do not normalize timezone.

requiredValidStreams: at least one valid collar sample
at least one valid halter classification
cohort.collarFeatures: The same twelve preregistered x/y/z mean, population standard deviation, minimum, and maximum features, using collar values only.
cohort.target: Unique majority of valid halter class labels in the same wall-clock window; halter labels never enter features.
cohort.ties: Retain and flag in coverage; null target and exclude from fitting/scoring.
cohort.partialBoundaries: Retain and flag windows extending beyond the README-advertised coverage interval in processed outputs; exclude them from fitting/scoring. README end timestamp is inclusive at displayed second, so exclusive bound is one second later. No padding.
cohort.eligibility: Exclude partial-boundary bins, bins missing either valid stream, tied/invalid halter majorities, bins with missing/nonfinite collar features, and bins with fewer than 800 valid samples in either stream. This fixed threshold is 800/900 (88.9%) of the nominal 10 Hz samples per 90-second window. Keep every window in processed Parquet; do not impute or pad.
cohort.coverage: Report union, collar-only, halter-only, common-valid, eligible, tie, partial-boundary, below-threshold, and per-stream valid sample counts for every output window and summarized by animal.
cohort.invalidOrDuplicateSamples: Do not contribute; do not synthesize or interpolate samples.

unchangedProtocol.features: Exactly the fixed feature list in preregistration.json.
unchangedProtocol.models: Exactly the fixed model procedures in preregistration.json; no search or tuning.
unchangedProtocol.animalGroupSplit: Keep each animal wholly in its README source split; source-test animals never enter development, fitting, or preprocessing.
unchangedProtocol.metricsAndInterpretationLimits: Unchanged from preregistration.json. Exploratory instrument agreement only, not independent validation.
